questions.q: What is a golden backtest set?
options: A set used for daily tuning
A frozen, versioned, representative set of series and origins for comparing models

questions.q: Which is part of a good promotion rule?
options: The challenger looks better on a chart
Average gain, win rate, no big loser segment and a live check

questions.q: Champion WAPE is 0.20 and challenger WAPE is 0.17. What is the relative lift? (decimal)
Scenario: you tested 60 variants and promoted the best. Live results are worse than the backtest. Why?
options: Selection effect: the maximum of many noisy scores is optimistic
why: Not always; the effect is systematic.

questions.q: Scenario: reported MAPE improves but bias becomes strongly negative. What do you do?
options: Investigate gaming: MAPE favours under-forecasts; report bias and a cost-based metric too

questions.q: Which is a good way to shrink the offline-online gap?
options: Backtest with the real data cut-off times and use point-in-time features
why: Fewer series do not fix it.

questions.q: What is Goodhart's law in this context?
options: When a metric becomes a target it can stop measuring what you care about
